title: AeroIslands
description: A modpack that tries to mix Create:Aeronautics with proper floating islands along side some extra additions to make exploration worth it!
body:
# Welcome to AeroIslands.
In this vast world you'll find:
- Incredible buildings (When Dungeons Arise).
- Surprisingly complex loot (Artifacts + Relics).
- Strong weaponary (Simple Swords + Bows).
- Incredible Machines (Create + Addons).
And much much more!!

All feedback will be appreciated! don't be afraid of disabling certain aspects or removing them from the modpack as this was made with the intent of being a pleasent survival experience.
